address: # EI level interrupt-control registers (EICn @ 0xFFFFB000 + 2*n). Named channels
# are those with verified firmware roles in docs/architecture/firmware-architecture.md.

name: EIC136
comment: TAUJ0 CH3 interrupt control (foreground tick; EIRF bit 12 polled)

address: # RSCFD / RSCAN-FD register bases used by Can transport (docs/communications/diagnostic-transport.md).
# Channel-0 bases match the firmware peripheral table at 0x23000; channel-1
# (application CAN1) and diagnostic Tx buffer n=16 are labeled explicitly.

name: CFSTS_CH1
comment: RSCFD common-FIFO status for application CAN1 (ch1/fifo0)

name: CFPCTR
comment: RSCFD common-FIFO pointer control base (write 0xFF advances)

name: CFPCTR_CH1
comment: RSCFD common-FIFO pointer control for application CAN1

name: CFDTMC
comment: RSCFD Tx message-buffer control base (CFDTMCn.TMTR at +n)

name: CFDTMC16
comment: Diagnostic Tx buffer control (HTH 0x13 -> n=16; TMTR bit 0)

name: CFDTMSTS
comment: RSCFD Tx message-buffer status base (CFDTMSTSn at +n)

name: CFDTMSTS_CH1
comment: RSCFD Tx status base for application CAN1 record

name: CFID
comment: RSCFD common-FIFO message RAM base (CFID/CFPTR/CFDF window)

name: CFID_CH1
comment: RSCFD common-FIFO message RAM for application CAN1

name: CFDTMID
comment: RSCFD Tx message-buffer RAM base (0x20-byte entries)

name: CFDTMID16
comment: Diagnostic Tx message RAM for buffer n=16 (CAN 0x7A9 path)

address: # ICUSCMD encoding is verified; companion offsets use firmware-observed roles.

name: ICUSCMD
comment: ICU-S command register; recovered MAC generate writes (selector<<16)|5 and CMAC verify writes (selector<<16)|7

name: ICUSDAT
comment: ICU-S data/parameter word written beside ICUSCMD (firmware role)

name: ICUSSTS
comment: ICU-S status; driver polls bit 0 as busy/ready

name: ICUSSTS2
comment: ICU-S companion status; driver polls low bits with ICUSSTS

name: ICUSCTL
comment: ICU-S control word written during driver reset/abort path

address: # CodeFlash ECC/address-parity safety registers from R01UH0585EJ0120 section 31.2.2.

name: UCFDERSTCLR
comment: CodeFlash ECC double-error and address-parity status clear

name: UCFDERSTR
comment: CodeFlash ECC double-error and address-parity status

name: UCFDEDADR
comment: CodeFlash double-error or address-parity error address

name: CFECCCTL_VCI2CFBA
comment: CodeFlash ECC control for system-interconnect access

name: CFSTSTCTL_VCI2CFBA
comment: CodeFlash ECC sub-test control for system-interconnect access

name: CFECCCTL_PE1
comment: CodeFlash ECC control for PE1 access

name: CFSTSTCTL_PE1
comment: CodeFlash ECC sub-test control for PE1 access

address: # EXTCLK1O clock-generation SFRs used by boot_extclk1_init (0x10C6).

name: CLKD3DIV
comment: EXTCLK1O divider; boot writes 0x50 for divide by 80

name: CLKD3STAT
comment: EXTCLK1O divider status; boot polls synchronization and active state

name: CKSC3C
comment: EXTCLK1O source selector; source 4 is CLK_LSB

name: CKSC3S
comment: EXTCLK1O selected-source status; boot polls until source 4 is active

address: # Error Control Module master and checker register windows.

name: ECMMPCMD0
comment: ECM master protection command; write 0xA5 before protected writes

name: ECMCPCMD0
comment: ECM checker protection command; write 0xA5 before protected writes

address: # Error Control Module common register window. This is not the flash sequencer.

name: ECMPCMD1
comment: ECM common protection command; write 0xA5 before protected writes

address: # Flash interface (FACI) register and command windows from R01UH0615EJ0120.
# TAUJ0 register landmarks used to derive the four application scheduler periods.
# ADCG result-source registers and DMAC channel-master settings used by the
# TAUJ0 CH0 phase-sample acquisition path. P1M-E manual register table maps
# ADCG0DIR00/ADCG1DIR00 at FFF91200/FFF92200 and DM00CM/DM10CM at
# FFFF8100/FFFF8120. Firmware DMA descriptors pair those ADCG sources with

name: ADCG0DIR00
comment: ADCG0 data supplementary information register 00; DMA source for sample ring

name: ADCG1DIR00
comment: ADCG1 data supplementary information register 00; DMA source for sample ring

name: DM00CM
comment: DMAC0 channel 0 channel master setting register

name: DM10CM
comment: DMAC1 channel 0 channel master setting register

address: # TSG3 motor-control timer extended HT-PWM compare registers. P1M-E manual

name: TSG30CMPWE
comment: TSG30 bit-extended HT-PWM W-phase compare register

name: TSG30CMPVE
comment: TSG30 bit-extended HT-PWM V-phase compare register

name: TSG30CMPUE
comment: TSG30 bit-extended HT-PWM U-phase compare register

name: TSG31CMPWE
comment: TSG31 bit-extended HT-PWM W-phase compare register

name: TSG31CMPVE
comment: TSG31 bit-extended HT-PWM V-phase compare register

name: TSG31CMPUE
comment: TSG31 bit-extended HT-PWM U-phase compare register
